bio: Karen Ruth Bass (; born October 3, 1953) is an American politician who has served as the 43rd mayor of Los Angeles since 2022. A member of the Democratic Party, Bass previously served in the U.S. House of Representatives from 2011 to 2022 and in the California State Assembly from 2004 to 2010, serving as speaker during her final term.
offices: Member of the California State Assembly (2004–2010)
Speaker of the California State Assembly (2008–2010)
Chair of the Congressional Black Caucus (2019–2021)
